basic_info.description: This carefully curated condominium blends the character of the past, built more than 100 years ago in 1919, with the sense of belonging and authenticity that is too often missing from modern day living. The gracious living room, with space to work and entertain, effortlessly flows to a generously sized dining room adjoined by an updated kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances and custom designer finishes. The primary bedroom grants direct access to the hall bathroom and there is enough separation of space between the two bedrooms to encourage private yet communal living.  A shared garden, laundry and an expansive storage room in this uniquely bikeable location complete this coveted home. This small, informally managed HOA is a safe haven for your furry friends too. If you have a car, you'll find ample perpendicular street parking on this block. Living car-free means having more time and resources to enjoy the best of the neighborhood. Soak in leisurely visits to Golden Gate Park, The Presidio, shops and restaurants without the hassle of parking or traffic.
